* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy.

* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

featured.description:
![](
https://i.postimg.cc/TY5kXM4C/Event-Management.png)

-----
## Welcome to the event!
### This November, Ponc Logistics X TurkishLine is hitting the road for a special ATS convoy, taking us from Elko Garage to Hilt Bitumen.
### Our journey will begin in the desert roads of Elko, surrounded by wide open landscapes and classic American highways. As we continue toward Hilt, drivers will experience a mix of long roads, scenic routes, and relaxing views across the western states.
### This convoy promises a calm yet enjoyable drive, bringing together our drivers for a memorable American Truck Simulator experience. Whether you are joining for the scenery, the road, or the community spirit, this route will offer a great time for everyone.
### As always, our CC team will be present throughout the convoy to ensure a safe, smooth, and enjoyable journey for all participants.
### Prepare your trucks, check your lights, and get ready to roll with us on this special November convoy —
### see you on the road! 🚛✨

today.name: BUY NOTHING´S DAY LTR FREE RIDE!
today.description:
## BUY NOTHING´S DAY FREE RIDE WITHOUT ANY BUYS! 🏷️
- Jízda ke dni bez nákupů z Německa do Rakouska se základními tahači!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/qg2Yu0c.jpeg)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The TRUCK for this convoy are restricted to be stock - no tuning.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:30** - Meet at the parking slots in Hannover.
*  **20:00**  - Departure from the Hannover towards heart of Germany.
*  **20:50**  - Passage around the city of Stuttgart.
*  **21:00**  - Passage around the city of Munich.
*  **21:25** - Arrival to the city of Innsbruck.
*  **21:30** - Final group photo and end of the convoy.



![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/CvKKMbu.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Hannover, Tradeaux  - Innsbruck, EuroGoodies.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## PRIVATE+PUBLIC SLOTS:

![](https://i.imgur.com/GRopZpm.jpeg)

## RESERVÉ SLOTS:

![](https://i.imgur.com/1bTGyNu.jpeg)



*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)


[![](https://i.imgur.com/c0lnezn.png)](https://trucksbook.eu/company/176895)

upcoming.name: 🚛✨ GROSSE LICHTERFAHRT DURCH DEUTSCHLAND |
upcoming.description:
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1537807478962651147/1568683030652915863/1.jpg?ex=6af0b56b&is=6aef63eb&hm=812e7ebf96203ff177bba3f7d40f88bb423004605781b5441cc8c128e2635ed2&)🚛✨ Köln nach Berlin: Die große Lichterfahrt! 🌃💡

Macht eure LKWs start klar und lasst uns gemeinsam die Straßen zum Leuchten bringen! 🚚💨

Unsere  Nachtfahrt von Köln nach Berlin steht an. Wir freuen uns auf jeden Fahrer, der mit uns durch die Nacht cruisen und für eine beeindruckende Lichtershow auf den Straßen von ETS2 sorgen möchte.

Schnappt euch euren Truck, schaltet eure Lichter ein und seid Teil unseres leuchtenden Konvois! 🔥
![](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1537807478962651147/1568682575457685504/Gemini_Generated_Image_7xtr047xtr047xtr.jpg?ex=6af0b4fe&is=6aef637e&hm=17135c1c0e483f87ab83f7844058efe5de826d3c9f0a5bf14d08ef4dc720d9be&=&format=webp)

💡 Licht-Setup & Konvoi-Regeln

✨ Beleuchtung: Zusatzscheinwerfer, Frontbügel und Grillleuchten sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Lasst eure Trucks strahlen!

⚠️ Beacons und Rundumleuchten: Bitte verwendet Rundumleuchten sparsam, damit wir unnötige Server-Lags vermeiden.

📏 Sicherheitsabstand: Haltet mindestens 80 bis 100 Meter Abstand zum vorausfahrenden LKW, damit alle sicher unterwegs sind.

⛽ Tank & Reparatur: Bitte erscheint mit einem vollständig betankten und reparierten LKW am Treffpunkt. So können wir ohne unnötige Unterbrechungen starten.

🤝 Fair Play: Achtet auf eure Mitfahrer, haltet euch an die Konvoi-Regeln und fahrt rücksichtsvoll.

🌟 Gemeinsam durch die Nacht!

Wir freuen uns auf einen unvergesslichen Abend mit euch, vielen beleuchteten Trucks und einer großartigen Gemeinschaft auf der Straße.

Packt eure schönsten Licht-Setups aus und seid dabei!

🚛 Gute Fahrt, bleibt unfallfrei und bis zum Konvoi! 💙✨
![](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1537807478962651147/1568682575080325271/Gemini_Generated_Image_n9y80vn9y80vn9y8.jpg?ex=6af0b4fe&is=6aef637e&hm=9cba78838f243de002adb11930669a31b11f00689689cb87dd10af43ec2921e8&=&format=webp)

Event Rules for Participants
The Event Staff are recognized as; “NextGen | PM, NextGen | ES, NextGen | CC, NextGen | Lead, NextGen | Tail, NextGen | GM or similar.
Free roaming is prohibited on this server.
Participants must haul a trailer.
Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
Overtaking on this server is prohibited.
Cars and Road Trip: Ford DLC are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.
Event Rules for Event Staff:
Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.
